# unifi_official_firewall_predefined_policy (Resource)

Manages the logging settings of a **predefined** firewall policy (`SYSTEM_DEFINED`, or `DERIVED` from another object) via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`) PATCH endpoint. Those are the only fields the controller (and the UI's policy table) lets you change on a predefined policy; everything else is read-only. Use `unifi_official_firewall_policy` for user-defined policies. Destroying the resource only removes it from state and leaves the policy as it is. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires a controller running 10.1.78+ with API-key authentication (Official API).

# Turn on syslog logging for a predefined policy (e.g. "Block Invalid Traffic").
resource "unifi_official_firewall_predefined_policy" "block_invalid" {
  policy_id       = "0b6a8c0e-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
  logging_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_id` (String) The Official API UUID of the predefined firewall policy. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `logging_enabled` (Boolean) Send a syslog entry when the policy matches (UI: "Syslog Logging"). Left as is when unset.
- `report_flow_enabled` (Boolean) Report matched traffic in Insights > Flows (UI: "Flow Logging"). The controller ignores it, and always reports false, for the Allow Return Traffic, multicast and IPv6 neighbor discovery policies. Left as is when unset. Requires UniFi Network 11.0.99 or later.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
- `name` (String) The policy name (read-only).
- `origin` (String) `SYSTEM_DEFINED` or `DERIVED` (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import using the site name and the policy's Official API UUID: <site>:<policyId>
terraform import unifi_official_firewall_predefined_policy.block_invalid default:0b6a8c0e-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
```
